groups.text: ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
groups.meaningfulComparison: Closing thanks/farewell only. Prior restaurant divides group bill before one guest leaves; current water split/secure bicycle basket, certificate two labeled envelopes, frozen-shopping order, staff trolley car loading, and stamp top-up each have different services, triggers and outcomes. Water vs trolley share beverage transport genre, but customer bicycle repacking versus staff car loading are different whole action sequences.
